Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Tempera Fixes
- Coat starts its cooldown display as soon as its use is captured, without waiting for a separate shield update.
- Captured shield updates that were previously missed.
- Shield breaks use the actual shield type: Coat removes 60 seconds and Grassa removes 30 seconds, even if an earlier application or conversion update was missed.
- Confirmed timers stay visible during the short wait before applying a shield-break reduction.
- Preserved expiry, conversion, death, and overwrite protections. Reset handling is unchanged.

Pictomancer Cooldowns
- Starry Muse is now listed with its proper name and icon instead of Scenic Muse. Existing saved selections continue working.
